changelog: Bulk 'Set Strategy' in the Trade Log: checkboxes + a 'Set Strategy (N)' action, scoped strictly to one challenge, with a confirmation stating how many trades will change. Reuses the existing trades.strategy_id mechanism (already re-import-safe) instead of inventing a new tagging concept.

Strategy/tag filter on Statistics and the Dashboard: All trades, No strategy, each strategy, or All except <strategy>. Applies only to performance figures (win rate, net P&L, profit factor, avg R, streak, every curve/breakdown) -- balance, the drawdown banner, the sidebar DD badge and the risk ladder never read it, so tagging 12 signal-follow trades can't change what those report.

Fixed: the Dashboard's drawdown curve (and max_drawdown_pct) flatlined at 0% for any account whose cumulative P&L never goes positive (e.g. an all-losses stretch) -- the peak-tracking guard required peak > 0, which an all-losses series never satisfies, even as real losses accumulated. Dropped that half of the guard; a real 12-trade, -884.42 series now correctly ends the curve at 8.84%, matching the account-level banner.

Fixed: the sidebar 'DD: X%' badge was a dead placeholder (index.php's own hardcoded 0%) until the Dashboard page happened to load first in the session -- the one function that refreshes the sidebar on every page load never touched it. Now wired through get_user's new dd_pct field (same staticDrawdownPct() formula the banner already used), so it's correct from the very first page load, Trade Log included.
release_notes: No DB migration -- application code only (StatsController.php, TradeController.php, ProfileController.php, router.php, three page templates, five JS files), no schema change. Verified with a disposable local integration test (not committed to this repo -- needs a local MySQL/MariaDB instance) against the real controllers over a real HTTP loopback (php -S; CLI SAPI has no php://input at all for bulkSetStrategy's real jsonInput()): 29/29 assertions, including the 8.8442% drawdown figure on an all-losses 12-trade series (not flatlined at 0, matching the account-level banner), the strategy filter's exact 12/0 split before and after tagging, challengeBalance()/dd_pct/current_drawdown_pct genuinely unchanged by both tagging and every filter value, strategy_id surviving a re-import-shaped matched-row UPDATE, and idempotent re-tagging. php -l and node --check pass clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean; full tools/ui-harness suite (13 drivers, none touching this release's files) passes -- one timing-sensitive assertion in drive-v3225.mjs failed once under concurrent load and passed clean on an isolated re-run, confirmed as an environment flake, not a regression.
